problem_statement: The team tracks on-call handoffs in a shared doc, which drifts out of date and causes missed handoffs.
purpose_and_goals: Provide a small CLI that records and displays the current on-call owner and handoff history.
target_users: Engineers on the on-call rotation for the platform team.
in_scope: Recording a handoff, showing the current owner, listing handoff history.
functional_requirements: CLI command to set the current owner; CLI command to show the current owner and last 10 handoffs.
integration_context: Runs locally on each engineer's machine; reads/writes a local JSON file, no server component.
acceptance_criteria: Running the set-owner command updates the recorded owner and appends a handoff entry with a timestamp.
priority_ranking: Must-have: set/show owner. Nice-to-have: handoff history listing.
timeline_and_cost_estimates: Roughly one day of effort; no ongoing cost since it is a local-only tool.
risks_and_assumptions: Assumes a single shared file is sufficient; no concurrent-write handling planned for v1.
security_and_risk_considerations: No secrets or credentials handled; local file only, no elevated privileges required; single user/role, no access levels needed.
supply_chain_security_expectations: Standard dependency scanning via existing repo tooling is sufficient; no additional artifact signing required.
cost_sensitivity: Not a cost concern; no external services used.

revision_history.change: Created the initial spec covering set/show owner and handoff history.
